el.Valores por propuesta · Temática, lugar: Rates per offering · Theme, place and dates to be agreed
el.¿Qué propuestas hay para retiros?: What offerings are available for retreats?
el.Tres: una clase de Hatha Yoga de 1 h 15: Three: a 1 h 15 min Hatha Yoga class, a 2 h 30 min workshop on breathwork, pranayamas and mantras, and "Baila tu respiración", 1 h 15 min.
el.Para organizadores de retiros, hoteles,: For organizers of retreats, hotels, country houses and teams who create wellness experiences and want to add a guided Yoga offering.
el.¿Se puede adaptar al grupo?: Can it be adapted to the group?
el.Sí. Cada propuesta se arma según el grup: Yes. Each offering is shaped around the group, the place and the time available. More than one can be combined within the same retreat.
el.Depende del formato, la duración y el lu: It depends on the format, the duration and the location. A quote is prepared for each retreat: write to us and we'll sort it out.
el.Son presenciales, en el lugar donde suce: They are held in person, wherever the retreat takes place. Piku travels as needed.
el.Contame la temática, el lugar y las fech: Tell me the theme, the place and the dates, and I'll prepare an offering tailored to your group.
